UI not bundled into this binary

The API is running and POST /detect works. This placeholder is what go:embed compiles in when the frontend has not been built into internal/webui/dist — which is the normal state for a local go build and for the test suite.

The production image replaces it: the Docker build runs npm run build and copies the bundle here before compiling. For local development, run the Vite dev server instead — it proxies to this API and gives hot reload, which a bundle compiled into a binary cannot.
